newsitem.title: USA: U.S. 3-, 6-month bills seen at 5.01, 5.10 percent.
newsitem.headline: U.S. 3-, 6-month bills seen at 5.01, 5.10 percent.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $14.0 billion in three- and six-month bills on Monday was expected to garner average discount rates of 5.01 percent and 5.10 percent, respectively, traders said.
In when-issued trade at about 1255 EDT/1655 GMT, the three-month bill was at 5.077 percent, while the six-month bill traded at 5.409 percent.
The bidding deadline for the auction is 1300 EDT/1700 GMT. Results are expected around 1345 EDT/1745 GMT.
